I saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, the memory store this project is set up to use. No earlier memory said anything different. The convention says:

- **All timestamps in the database are stored in UTC.**
- **Only the API layer converts them to the customer's timezone.** Everything below the API layer (database, models, business logic) works in UTC.

It's tagged with timezone, UTC, timestamps, database and API, so it should come up when someone works on timestamp handling or API responses.
